spec.description: Dagger check and function durations, cache hit rate, CI failures and in-cluster engine resource usage. See k8s/platform/dagger-engine/README.md and docs/dagger-traces.md.
Only runs where a process ran under the check, so this is the cost of a cache miss. Tempo, 7 days; quantiles come from power-of-two buckets. Legend: 90th percentile of the plotted values.
spec.title: Check duration p90 when executed (slowest 10)

spec.description: Wall clock of each `dagger check` run in Woodpecker over the selected range, in 30s buckets (Tempo search, at most 1000 runs).
spec.title: CI run duration

spec.description: Daily mean per check from VictoriaMetrics, which keeps only _sum and _count. Widen the time range to see months.
spec.title: Mean check duration, long-term (slowest 10)

spec.description: Mean time in each module function's own body, e.g. toolchain setup. Check functions return a lazy container, so their work shows under the check, not here.
spec.title: Module function self time (slowest 10)

spec.description: p90 and mean wall clock, runs and failures per check (Prometheus). Checks with no runs in the range are left out.
spec.title: Checks in the selected range

spec.description: Check runs that ran a process of their own (Executed) and ones that came entirely from the cache (Cached). The module's /runtime, which every check runs, doesn't count (Tempo).

spec.description: dagger.io/cache.outcome of module function calls (Prometheus). Check functions report `executed` even when their execs were cached; see the panel on the left for checks.

spec.description: Check runs that ran a process of their own, per check (Tempo). Checks that miss the cache on most runs have an input that changes every time.
spec.title: Most often executed checks

spec.description: Checks run in the selected range, CI and local (Tempo, at most 7 days).
spec.title: Check runs

spec.description: Failures per check, CI and local (Tempo).
spec.title: Failed check runs

spec.description: Each failed check span in a Woodpecker run, linked to its trace (Tempo search).
spec.title: Failed checks in CI

spec.description: Pod: the engine and every exec it runs (cAdvisor). Engine process: the engine alone, without its execs (telemetry.resourceMetrics). Limit and Throttled (right axis, share of CFS periods that hit the limit) appear only while the pod has a CPU limit.
spec.title: CPU

spec.description: Pod working set (cAdvisor), split into the engine process and everything else in the pod: execs, git and other helpers. The stack's top is the pod's working set, the number the kubelet compares with the limit. Working set leaves out inactive page cache, which the kernel reclaims before an OOM kill.
spec.title: Memory

spec.description: Pod network throughput (cAdvisor): image pulls, uploads from clients, exec traffic.
spec.title: Network

spec.description: Disk used by the engine's local cache. GC keeps it under 150GB and 15% free space on the 200Gi volume.
spec.title: Local cache size

spec.description: Dagger clients connected to the engine: CI pipelines and anyone using it directly.
spec.title: Connected clients

spec.description: Share of check runs that ran no process of their own: everything they needed came from the cache. Every check also runs its module's /runtime to define the check, which doesn't count (Tempo).
spec.title: Cache hit rate

spec.description: Share of check runs that ran a process (cache misses) and passed. Cached runs repeat an earlier result, so they are left out (Tempo).
spec.title: Executed check pass rate
